SMTO-GML-0011 — Your email change no longer matches the preview you approved

GUID: 2d714cad-8b86-4bb9-8c36-41204313dca5
Slug: gmail-bulk-selection-mismatch
Domain: GML · Subsystem: gml

What happened

  • SMTO prepared a preview of emails to change, but the change it was about to make didn't match that preview exactly, so it stopped. No emails were changed by this attempt.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask SMTO to search your mailbox again and show a new preview of the emails it will change. The old preview was tied to one exact account, action and set of emails, and the request no longer matched it.
  2. Check that the preview names the right Gmail account, the right action (for example archive or mark as read) and the right label. A different account, action or label than the one previewed is exactly what makes SMTO stop.
  3. If you reconnected or switched the Gmail account since the preview, wait until that is finished before asking for the new preview. Changes to the saved account also make an older preview no longer match.

What success looks like

  • SMTO shows a new preview, you approve it, and SMTO reports the emails as changed.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't ask SMTO to reuse the old email list; always ask for a fresh preview.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Gmail batch_modify rejected the selection_token because the account, operation, label, explicit message IDs or recomputed account-and-selection hash differ from the captured preview.

What this means

  • A bulk token's account/action/label, explicit ID list or recomputed account-and-selection hash differs from the captured preview. Gmail provider receipts and exact account/message identities determine effects. Authorization, pagination or presentation failure cannot undo a send or other mutation; diagnostic rendering performs no mailbox or OAuth request.

Why this can happen

  • A bulk token's account/action/label, explicit ID list or recomputed account-and-selection hash differs from the captured preview.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare account/app identity, message IDs, operation and label against the original preview.

How to fix it

  • GmailService.batch_modify_messages compares the stored selection's account_ref, operation, label_name, message_ids and SHA-256 selection_hash (account key, email, oauth_app_ref or account updated_at, IDs, operation, label) with the request. Run gmail.preview_modify again for the current account and action, then call gmail.batch_modify with the new selection_token and the same account_ref/operation/label_name, omitting message_ids.
  • Refresh the search and preview and reconfirm the exact current selection.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • A deliberately refreshed exact preview is confirmed for the intended current selection.

What not to do

  • Do not submit a stale identifier or revision after another actor changed the resource.

Technical notes

  • Gmail provider receipts and exact account/message identities determine effects. Authorization, pagination or presentation failure cannot undo a send or other mutation; diagnostic rendering performs no mailbox or OAuth request.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
